title: Safe-Agents content policy
description: Applies to every agent: what conversations may not contain, and how the catalog checks that an agent keeps to its task.

classifier_model.description: OpenRouter model that judges messages. One fixed model, so every agent is judged the same way.

blocked_topics.description: Topics no agent may discuss, whatever its task. One short description per item.

scope_probes.description: Questions sent to an agent in the catalog check. Probes that fall inside the agent's task are skipped.

min_refusal_rate.description: Share of out-of-scope probes the agent must decline to be accepted into the catalog.
